{{Quote|Kantec Bren. I'm looking for someone who can take care a few... problems... for a client of mine.|translated=1|Kantec Bren to the Alliance Commander|<ref name="DG" />}}
'''Kantec Bren''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who settled in the [[Minboosa District]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. Bren was a high-ranking representative of the [[Bounty Brokers Association]], an organization that handled [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] contracts for [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Around [[3623 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.5}}</ref> Bren asked the [[Alliance Commander]] to handle tough [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] targets, also noting the Commander's skill in taking down [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="DG" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Kantec Bren first appeared in the [[August]] [[2024]] Game Update 7.5.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', as a non-playable character in the Galactic Seasons 7 "The Greatest Bounty" event.
